coverage.claim: All identified main tabs and dynamic feature groups have current operator guidance; not every dynamic control or device has been exercised.

layout.visualReview: Landing page, guide index and Audio chapter reviewed in representative desktop/mobile screenshots; no clipping or page-level overflow.

pdfs.review: First pages with changed prefaces visually inspected; retained print styling and historical content. Not a claim of a new line-by-line visual audit of all 129 pages.

audioTutorial.scope: Real UI authoring, Play/Stop, edit/Undo, downloaded native project, file-chooser reopen, viewer build and ROM download. Controlled execution of emitted 6502 verifies four periods, cut and repeat.

retainedApplicationEvidence.reason: Entire app payload and bundled HTML are unchanged; existing exact-byte application evidence is retained.

limitations: Full nine-step first-game owner tutorial was source-reviewed, not newly replayed end to end.
Native OS Save As dialog, physical phone/controller, audible listening and NES hardware acceptance remain untested in this review.
Headless viewport checks do not certify a physical mobile device.
Controlled APU calls do not establish full-game timing or audible equivalence.
In-app TECH DOCS and some source guides retain older overview text; current kit chapters explicitly take precedence.
